repo.description: GitHub repository name. Globs are allowed.

ownerlessAllowed.description: Whether repositories are allowed to have no administrators

userAdminsAllowed.description: Whether users are allowed to be admins on the repository. If false then only teams can be admins.

userAdmins.description: Specific users allowed to administer this repository. Overrides the boolean setting userAdminsAllowed.

maxNumberUserAdmins.description: Maximum number of users with admin permissions allowed on this repository. Takes effect only if greater than zero.

teamAdminsAllowed.description: Whether teams are allowed to be admins on the repository. If false then only users can be admins.

teamAdmins.description: Specific teams allowed to administer this repository. Overrides the boolean setting teamAdminsAllowed.

maxNumberAdminTeams.description: Maximum number of teams with admin permissions allowed on this repository. Takes effect only if greater than zero.

optConfig.description: Standard org-level opt-in or opt-out configuration. RepoOverride applies to all configuration.

action.description: Which action to take. Default log; other options include issue.

ownerlessAllowed.description: Whether repositories are allowed to have no administrators

userAdminsAllowed.description: Whether users are allowed to be admins on a repository. If false then only teams can be admins.

maxNumberUserAdmins.description: Maximum number of users with admin permissions allowed on a repository. Takes effect only if greater than zero.

teamAdminsAllowed.description: Whether teams are allowed to be admins on a repository. If false then only users can be admins.

maxNumberAdminTeams.description: Maximum number of teams with admin permissions allowed on a repository. Takes effect only if greater than zero.

exemptions.description: List of exemption entries for repositories and admin allowances. Only defined at org level.

optConfig.description: Standard repo-level opt-in or opt-out configuration.

action.description: Override for org-level action when present

ownerlessAllowed.description: Override for org-level ownerlessAllowed when present

userAdminsAllowed.description: Override for org-level userAdminsAllowed when present

maxNumberUserAdmins.description: Override for org-level maxNumberUserAdmins when present

teamAdminsAllowed.description: Override for org-level teamAdminsAllowed when present

maxNumberAdminTeams.description: Override for org-level maxNumberAdminTeams when present
